Hey, I know I'm not the best person to console anyone because I've never had to do that for anyone else like ever. but disha you're an amazing person, I know you've been managing everything in the house from cooking food to taking care of agu and being the perfect daughter, and I know how it feels to be not heard by your parents or get acknowledged for things you've been doing for your career and your family as well. you've been no less than a perfect daughter, perfect sister, and even a perfect friend to everyone around you. I know you're not someone who's even jealous of your sister, wanting the attention from your parents is like the base desire and there's nothing wrong in that and I can empathize with it totally. look don't know if uncle aunty have been like just after neerja left for us or not. but it's totally valid to feel this way and maybe uncle aunty are overcompensating with neerja right now, but between prepping for janoi and running the whole hospital they might be loosing a little perspective on how they should've treated you. but despite all this, you've held everything together without letting it break you and that's not something small. like I genuinely mean it when I say most people would've cracked or just stopped caring by now, but you're still showing up every single day doing everything that needs to be done without even expecting anything in return. and I think that says so much about who you are as a person.

I know it hurts when the people you're doing everything for don't see it or acknowledge it, and I'm not gonna sit here and tell you that you shouldn't feel hurt because you absolutely should. your feelings are completely valid and you deserve to be seen and appreciated for everything you do. like it's not about comparing yourself to neerja or anyone else, it's just about wanting your parents to notice you and what you bring to the table, and that's the most human thing ever.

I really hope uncle aunty realize soon what they have right in front of them, because honestly they're lucky to have someone like you who cares so much even when it feels like no one's noticing. and even if they take time to figure it out, I need you to know that you're doing enough, you're being enough, and you don't need their validation to prove your worth even though I know how much it would mean coming from them.

and look I know I messed up earlier by trying to jump in with solutions and suggestions when you just needed someone to listen. I'm sorry for that, I wasn't trying to make it about anything else or take away from what you were feeling, I just didn't know how to be there properly and I ended up doing the exact opposite of what you needed. you're not invisible disha, at least not to the people who actually pay attention. I see you, I see everything you're doing and everything you are, and you're genuinely one of the most selfless and strongest people I know. so please don't let this make you doubt yourself or your worth because you're so much more than just what you do for others, you're valuable just by being you.
also please sleep after you write the long ass paragraph to soham gupta and I hope you're hydrated
